race.comment: PIRANI PERFECT (4) has been in the placings two times from as many appearances this campaign. Recorded yet another strong performance last time when she battled on bravely to just miss out over 1690m at Kilmore, adding to a string of recent minor placings. Ideally placed and is sure to prove tough to beat. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was disappointing last start when fifth over 1750m at Swan Hill after two wins and three minor placings from his previous five starts. Must overcome a very wide draw. The recent run not a true indication. Good enough to take out a race like this. HURRICANE HOOLY (5) is in the mix following a respectable second at her most recent appearance over 1710m at Ballarat. ROJENBYE (3) disappointed last time when sixth over 2190m at Mildura. Can do a lot better so worth considering.
